widgets_values:
One frozen instant. Only the camera moves. In a continuous 360 orbit.

No wobbling, shaking, spinning, drifting, falling or continued action. Camera parallax is the only source of apparent movement. No cuts, zoom, morphing or added objects.

The world is COMPLETELY STILL, nothing is moving except the camera.
